modern: Constantly, and, if possible, on the occasion of every impression on the soul, apply to it the principles of Physics, of Ethics, and of Dialectic.

explained.summary: Whenever something strikes you, test it against the three parts of Stoic philosophy: physics (how the world actually works), ethics (how to live well) and logic (how to reason clearly). Marcus wants philosophy applied constantly to each passing thought and impression, not saved for study.
